entries.title: II Chronicles 12:1
segments: Great prosperity is dangerous; when it is granted men are increasingly prone to rebel against God, and thus to bring ruin upon themselves and those who join with them.

entries.title: II Chronicles 12:3
segments: Lubim--Sukkiim--Ethiopians; people living in countries bordering upon Egypt.

entries.title: II Chronicles 12:6
segments: When men become sensible of their sins, ascribe righteousness unto God, and humble themselves before him, he is ready to forgive and save them from that destruction which their sins deserve.

entries.title: II Chronicles 12:12
segments: Things went well; there were yet some good men, and things went well compared with what they had done.

entries.title: II Chronicles 12:14
segments:
He prepared not his heart; his reformation was merely external. 
 
Reformations which are merely external and in which the heart is not engaged, will not avail to the permanent removal of calamities in this world, or save the soul from destruction in the world to come.

entries.title: II Chronicles 12:15
segments: Of Iddo the seer concerning genealogies; that is, the book of Iddo the seer, which has for its object to give genealogical registers. These registers also contained notices of the acts of the persons whose genealogy was given.
